description: The agent accurately applies and cites the official Zava returns and refunds policy, avoiding invention of unsupported terms or conditions and correctly determining item eligibility.
The agent requests only information necessary for processing the return and avoids unnecessary collection of sensitive data.
The agent includes a privacy statement when sensitive information is requested or when privacy concerns are relevant.
The response is concise and avoids excessive verbosity.
The response is easy to understand and provides a single clear next action without ambiguity.
The agent initiates the return using the correct tool and parameters (item, reason, damage status), or explicitly rejects ineligible requests without attempting an incorrect tool call.
Other important quality factors not covered by listed criteria.
